summary: Iteration 14 tested: real Supabase integration, PlatformAccessScreen 4-step flow, refactored CTAs and backend /api/stripe/create-checkout. 15/16 spec items PASS end-to-end. The only blocker: Supabase signUp endpoint returns HTTP 500 for the test email domain, so the signup→auto-auth→plan→Stripe chain couldn't be fully exercised via the form (this is a Supabase project-side response, not a frontend bug — spec explicitly allowed either auto-auth or auth-info outcome, but we got neither because Supabase itself errored). Everything else works as designed.

integration_issues.issue: supabase.auth.signUp returns HTTP 500; AuthForm surfaces the supabase-js parse error 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' inside data-testid=auth-error. Root cause is external (Supabase project) — likely email-domain validator / signups disabled in the dashboard. Frontend behavior (catching the error, disabling the button during await, clearing previous state) is correct.

action_items: Verify Supabase Auth settings for project ukootpnechabpmwsmxsi: (1) 'Enable email signups' is ON, (2) email-domain allowlist is not blocking test/throwaway domains, (3) rate-limits are not tripped. Once signup returns 200, the full AuthForm → choose_plan → Stripe chain should complete automatically (frontend code is correct).

Optional robustness: in AuthForm.handleSubmit, wrap the supabase-js call result inspection so that a 500 with unparseable body renders a friendlier message like 'El servicio de autenticación no respondió. Intenta de nuevo.' instead of the raw 'body stream already read' string.
critical_code_review_comments: useUserBillingState.js: good rewrite — real session bootstrap, onAuthStateChange subscription, proper mounted.current cleanup, VALID_PLANS normalization. No issues.

PlatformAccessScreen.jsx is ~620 lines and mixes PLAN_TIERS config + PlatformCard + StepIndicator + the main component. Reasonable for now but consider extracting PlanTierCard and StepIndicator to /components/platform/* if it grows further.

billingGuards.deriveBillingState marks profiles with plan but null stripe_subscription_id as 'expired'. This will flag freshly inserted rows (where webhook hasn't landed yet) as expired; consider also checking plan_updated_at age or a dedicated status column.

AuthForm.jsx: good UX with isolated error/info slots. Minor — no explicit 'email format' validation before calling supabase; supabase will reject but a client-side regex check would save a network round-trip.

Backend create_stripe_checkout: metadata merge guards against overwrites (k not in metadata) — good. Consider stringifying only primitive values in body.metadata (current str(v) will stringify dicts/lists into unreadable blobs).
checkoutResume.loadIntent 1h TTL + try/catch around sessionStorage — solid.

(2) Navbar 'Comenzar' + Hero 'Comenzar' CTAs both open PlatformAccessScreen modal via data-testid=nav-cta / hero-cta-primary. Once Supabase signup works, main agent can manually verify by creating one account through the UI and clicking any plan tile — network tab should show POST to /api/stripe/create-checkout with body containing plan/billing_cycle/user_id/metadata, and window.location should then go to Stripe.
rca of the issue: Supabase signUp 500: the REST call to https://ukootpnechabpmwsmxsi.supabase.co/auth/v1/signup returned a 5xx with a non-JSON/empty body, so supabase-js's internal `.json()` parse crashed with 'body stream already read' (actually it's trying to re-read after the first parse attempt failed). Since the 500 comes from Supabase itself (external service), no frontend change fixes this — the Supabase project needs 'Enable email signups' toggled on and/or the email domain allowlist relaxed. Reproduction: open PlatformAccessScreen → pick OS → switch to signup → submit any email+password(>=8) → observe data-testid=auth-error surfaced + console shows 'Failed to load resource: status 500'. Mitigation: configure the Supabase project's Auth → Providers → Email settings; optionally upgrade supabase-js error handling so 5xx upstream renders a cleaner message.
